method: Eight whole text files read. README contiguous1-350,351-EOF; license1-340,341-EOF. Four whole SCSS plus two identical CSS files; individual SHA/Git identities verified. Docs commands/instructions treated as source material, never executed.
findings: README explicitly defines Related Tree as connected similarity chain where endpoints may differ. Earlier chain control is intentional similarity semantics, not automatically a defect; unsuitable for verified all-pairs file duplicate identity.

README explicitly instructs Reset Records before threshold changes. This is documented manual mitigation; original settings callback still does not invalidate/reverify displayed groups automatically. Narrowed prior v11 conclusion accordingly.

README labels .97+ / .98-.999 as exact duplicates, but implementation is normalized ResNet152 cosine candidates, no byte equality proof. Threshold claims lack independently verified positive/negative corpus in read repository.
README describes atomic DB+XMP rollback. Earlier owned controls/source show backup-before-try loss and externally committed DB trash before later local failure; broad atomicity claim unsupported.
README Sync Behavior says re-fetch reconciles current state; earlier equal-count fetch-disable, stale vector flags on changed thumbnail and filtered-thumbnail deletion controls limit that claim.
README says higher resolution criterion; original JS metric sums width+height instead of pixel area. README criterion weight range0-5 differs options built with range(5),0-4.
README preferred GPU choice says default image tag while later tag table/compose state latest is CPU. Source tag matrix remains authoritative for pinned configuration.
README same-host database hostname initially container-name guidance, later env section says service-name. Compose example comments emphasize service name; actual runtime resolution not tested.

Root LICENSE whole text is GPL version3 with standard terms and application appendix. README identifies GPLv3. Recorded as source/license inventory, no legal compatibility conclusion; no upstream production code copied.

SCSS base establishes theme variables, widths10-100%, shared mixins. bs5 redefines btn-colors mixin and uses global input/disabled/control overrides; comp defines task panel/modal/selection cues and animated tooltips. Source review is not rendered UI acceptance.

fn.css and ico.css are exact-byte duplicate icon styles, both credited after identity check; duplicate selector load could be redundant but no measured runtime/performance claim. Inline SVG stack icon data is presentation source.
No styles or read documentation establish matcher quality, model/device parity, recoverability or end-to-end runtime proof.
